findings.explanation: Invoice number CS-2026-0338 is already recorded in INV-H012 from the same supplier. The contract says each bill carries its own serial number and repeated bills for an already billed consignment are not payable.
findings.quote: Every bill carries its own serial number and covers one consignment only. Repeated bills for an already billed consignment are not payable.
